## Order on the form of the expenses account

The account must be revised to distinguish preparation, attendance and copying charges. The present order concerns presentation of the account only. It does not determine the final sum recoverable between the parties.

Preparation time must be recorded against the relevant task. A single undifferentiated entry for “case work” is insufficient where part of the recorded time concerns another matter. Copying charges must state the number of pages and the rate used.

The provisional total of GBP 420 is an amount under review. The proposed attendance date is 14 January 2027. Section 5.1, article 18 and schedule 4 apply to the account procedure.

The revised account is to be supplied within seven days. Objections must identify the item disputed and the correction sought.

All questions concerning entitlement to the disputed expenses are reserved.
